name: commix
description: Automated All-in-One OS Command Injection Exploitation Tool.

name: vulnerable-java-application
description: This repository contains a sample Java application vulnerable to command injection and server-side request forgery (SSRF).

name: Injekta
description: Injekta is a feature-rich Discord bot built with TypeScript that helps users manage their hormone replacement therapy (HRT) injections. It logs injection data, automatically sends reminders, and provides interactive commands to track your injection schedule—all integrated with Supabase for persistent data storage.

name: WAF_Project
description: A Web Application Firewall (WAF) built with Flask to detect and block SQL Injection, XSS, Command Injection, and LFI/RFI attacks. Features logging, rate limiting, and Docker deployment.

name: BlindExtractor
description: A fast, multi-processed command-line tool for exploiting blind injection vulnerabilities (error/time-based) with an interactive shell interface.

name: RapidConsole
description: A project for creating a command-line application that can run on .NET on Windows, Linux and macOS with support for commands, dependency injection, logging, and a whole lot more.
